mcqs.question: The Sea of Japan (East Sea) is bounded by which of the following countries?
options: Japan, Russia, North Korea and South Korea
Japan, Russia, China and South Korea
Japan, North Korea, South Korea and China
Russia, North Korea, South Korea and China
mcqs.explanation: The Sea of Japan is bounded by Japan, Russia, North Korea and South Korea. The tempting alternatives are incorrect because they replace one of these four countries with China.
